The '''Delriss system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delriss]], which was orbited by a [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Aquatic moon of Delriss|moon]] upon which a [[Jedi sanctuary]] was located.<ref name="Chronicles" />
